D: A grumpy Korean War veteran in Detroit stops the Hmong boy next door stealing his 1972 Gran Torino, and slowly becomes family.
P: Serve the skewers when Sue brings Walt to the barbecue next door.
S: Grilled Hmong pork sausage with chilli dip
Lemongrass pork sausage grilled with a chilli dip. Walt is out of beer.

Mix the pork with the lemongrass, half the garlic, spring onion, fish sauce, chilli flakes and a little salt. Shape into thick logs on skewers and chill while the grill heats. Char the whole chillies on the grill, then pound them with the rest of the garlic, lime juice, coriander and salt into a dip. Grill the sausages, turning, until browned and cooked through, then slice and serve with the dip.
2 lemongrass stalks, white part finely chopped@Produce
Pounded green papaya salad with lime and chilli. No touching heads at the barbecue.

Pound the garlic, chillies and palm sugar in a mortar. Add the beans and tomatoes and bruise them lightly. Add the papaya, fish sauce and lime juice and pound and toss until it softens a little. Pile onto a plate and scatter with peanuts.
M: Lemongrass chicken skewers with sticky rice
Lemongrass chicken skewers with sticky rice. Food piles up on Walt's porch.

Steam the drained rice in a lined steamer until tender and sticky. Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and oil and toss the chicken through. Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through. Serve with the sticky rice, herbs and lime wedges.
800g chicken thigh fillets, cut in strips@Meat
Kielbasa with caraway sauerkraut, for Walt the retired Ford factory man.

Cook the onion slowly in the butter, then add the sauerkraut and caraway and warm through. Score the kielbasa and grill, turning, until blistered and hot through. Serve on the rolls with the kraut and mustard.
W: Coconut tapioca pudding with pandan jelly. Walt leaves the Gran Torino to Thao.

Boil the tapioca in plenty of water until clear, then rinse in cold water. Boil the water with the agar, half the sugar and the pandan, pour into a tray and chill until set, then cut into strips. Warm the coconut milk with the rest of the sugar and the salt until dissolved, then chill. Spoon tapioca and jelly into glasses, add ice and pour over the coconut milk.
K: Pabst Blue Ribbon on the porch
Cold cans of Pabst Blue Ribbon in ice. Walt's empties stack up on the porch.
Bury the cans in ice. Hand them out and stack the empties.
8 x 355ml cans Pabst Blue Ribbon beer@Bottle shop
